name: Katagiri Asuka
source: Asuka is a very close childhood friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]. She became his girlfriend after their experiences from last year. She often gets angry at him but that's because she puts up with more than other girls would ever take so Takuya could consider himself to be very lucky to have her by his side. Will their relationship survive another [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]girl transformation trouble[/url] that seem to often befall poor Takuya?
